summary: The candidate implements the issue-specific stable copy-in policy for custom all-reduce during DSA decode with DP attention, and preserves direct registration outside that configuration. Its regression fails on the recorded base and passes on the candidate; independent runtime-policy and single-gfx950 stable-address graph checks also pass. The full eight-GPU TP8/DP4 GLM-5.2 failure remains unverified because only one GPU and no model weights were available.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution of the exact candidate regression: 9/9 cases failed because the base lacks the DSA+DP capture policy and selected capture-path field.
9/9 candidate policy, capture-path, SGLang dispatch, deterministic dispatch, and AITER dispatch cases passed.
104 tests and 140 subtests passed, covering the candidate regression and the runtime-context subsystem it newly reads during communicator dispatch.
On one MI350X gfx950, four separately captured graphs used one stable BF16 address and replayed in reverse order; observed FP32 sums exactly matched [8192, 4096, 2048, 1024].

tests.command: independent inline runtime-context policy check retained as /job/review-evidence-j-f56691c80e7c/independent-runtime-policy.txt
tests.what_was_measured: Actual ServerArgs publication selected copy-in for DSA decode plus DP attention, including split decode DSA, while preserving direct registration for DSA without DP attention and prefill-only DSA.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, ran the stable-address CUDA/HIP graph numerical fixture. This was not a distributed custom-all-reduce run.

remaining_counterexamples: No eight-GPU TP8/DP4 execution was possible, so graph-skewed peer IPC custom-all-reduce remains an unexecuted original-contract case.
No GLM-5.2-MXFP4 weights were available, so all-NaN logits and repeated token ID 0 were not reproduced before or verified absent after.
The single-GPU fixture does not exercise AITER or SGLang multi-rank custom-all-reduce kernels, peer registration, or incomplete collectives.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the original environment requires eight MI350X GPUs.
Model weights were unavailable, so semantic output and throughput were not measured.
No native source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate PR body references mirror issue 1259, while this reviewed task identifies mirror issue 1361; the review report and delivery PR use 1361.
